questions.q: What does the Grouping pane show?
options: Row Groups and Column Groups for the currently selected data region
The full list of every data source in the report, regardless of selection
The report's version history
Only parameters, never groups
questions.explain: The Grouping pane displays Row Groups and Column Groups for whichever data region is currently selected on the design surface.

questions.q: Why is the Report Builder design surface described as "not WYSIWYG"?
options: The size of the design surface has no relationship to the physical page size you'll print or export to
It can only display text, no images
It renders in black and white only
It cannot be resized at all
questions.explain: Growing or shrinking the design surface doesn't change your print area — item position matters, but the canvas itself is just a workspace, not a page preview.

questions.q: You right-click the white area of the design surface, outside any report item. What dialog do you get?
options: Body Properties
Report Properties
Data Source Properties
Page Setup only, with no other options
questions.explain: Right-clicking the white body area (outside any item) opens Body Properties — border and fill for the report body itself.

questions.q: Where do you go to change a report's page setup, such as paper size and margins?
options: Right-click the gray area around the design surface and select Report Properties
Right-click the white body area and select Body Properties
The Report Data pane's New menu
Page setup cannot be changed in Report Builder
questions.explain: Report Properties, reached by right-clicking the gray/blue area around the design surface, includes page setup settings like paper size and margins.

questions.q: The Ruler and Properties panes are off by default. Where do you turn them on?
options: The View tab's Show/Hide group
The Home tab's Clipboard group
The Insert tab
They cannot be toggled — they're always hidden
questions.explain: Both the Ruler and Properties panes are toggled on or off from the View tab's Show/Hide group.
